markup:
The number of drone batteries you can fully recharge during a day away from your truck depends mainly on your **power station's capacity (Wh)** and your **drone battery's capacity (Wh)**.

A useful estimate is:

\[
\text{Full recharges}=\frac{\text{Power station Wh}\times0.85}{\text{Drone battery Wh}}
\]

The 0.85 factor accounts for roughly 15% energy loss during charging.

## Estimated full battery recharges

Assuming you're starting with a fully charged power station, with no solar input:

| Power station | 50 Wh drone battery | 80 Wh drone battery | 100 Wh drone battery |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 300 Wh | 5 | 3 | 2 |
| 500 Wh | 8 | 5 | 4 |
| 1,000 Wh | 17 | 10 | 8 |
| 1,500 Wh | 25 | 15 | 12 |
| 2,000 Wh | 34 | 21 | 17 |

These are approximate complete recharges, not the total number of flights. Any drone batteries you bring already charged add to your available flights.

## Calculate your setup

{@body const [station,setStation]=DIL.useState("1000")}
{@body const [battery,setBattery]=DIL.useState("80")}
{@body const [efficiency,setEfficiency]=DIL.useState(85)}
{@body const s=Math.max(0,Number(station)||0)}
{@body const b=Math.max(0,Number(battery)||0)}
{@body const count=b>0?Math.floor(s*efficiency/100/b):0}
<box border radius="2xl" padding={3} gap={3}>
  <grid columns={2} gap={3}>
    <grid-item>
      <label>Power station capacity (Wh)</label>
      <input inputType="number" value={station} onChange={setStation}/>
    </grid-item>
    <grid-item>
      <label>Drone battery capacity (Wh)</label>
      <input inputType="number" value={battery} onChange={setBattery}/>
    </grid-item>
  </grid>
  <row align="center" justify="between">
    <label>Charging efficiency</label>
    **{efficiency}%**
  </row>
  <slider min={70} max={95} step={5} value={efficiency} onChange={setEfficiency}/>
  <box background="surface-secondary" radius="xl" padding={3} align="center" gap={1}>
    <text color="secondary" weight="medium" size="sm">Estimated full recharges</text>
    <title size="2xl" color="default" tabularNums>{count}</title>
    <caption>From one full power station charge</caption>
  </box>
</box>

For a full day away from your truck, charging speed also matters. A station might have enough energy for 10 recharges but not enough charging output or time to complete them all.

**Which drone model and portable power station are you using?** With those two models, I can estimate how many batteries you can recharge in an 8–10-hour flying day, including charging time and realistic power losses.
